QuestInfo.name: Lolo's Sap
QuestInfo.0: Lolo wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1: Collect #b20 globs of Polishing Sap#k from the Evil Eyes in the Giant Tree so that Lolo can make the library more fancy.
QuestInfo.2: When you gave the Polishing Sap to Lolo, Grendel the Really Old was back. Talk to him.

0.0: I gotta get back to my cleaning. Did the scroll help?\r\n#L0##bIndeed. I am indebted to you.#l\n#k
0.1: In THAT case, I've got another favor to ask!\r\n#L0##bWhat would you have me do?#l\n#k
0.2: I found some old, beat up books when I was cleaning. If I had some Polishing Sap, I could fix 'em up good as new.\r\n#L0##bThe Polishing Sap will be yours.#l\n#k
0.3: Great! The Evil Eyes outside Ellinia are loaded with the stuff. I think their eye goobers are made of Polishing Sap.

1.0: Great. That's all the Polishing Sap I need.

yes.0: Oh, Grendel's back! I bet he can help you out.

item.0: The Evil Eyes are scary. If they weren't, I'd get the Polishing Sap myself.
